THE EVIDENCE BEHIND THE VIEW

What the numbers mean

Your map setup

This app uses Leaflet 1.9.4 and OpenStreetMap tiles. No map API key is required for this basemap. The lines come from your supplied MTC GIS files.

  1. Keep the OpenStreetMap attribution visible.
  2. ETM stages are matched to stop names near the route. Unmatched sections stay grey.
  3. Colors show a planning load under your service assumption, not an observed crowd count.
  4. For heavier public traffic, choose a suitable tile provider and update the tile URL.

For Google Maps: create a Cloud project, link billing for standard production use, enable Maps JavaScript API, create a key and restrict it to your website origins and that API. Draw a separate colored Polyline for each mapped section.
